chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Yaqoub ibn Zayd, from Ziyad al-Qandy, from Abu Wakie, from Abu Ishaq al-Sabiee, from Al-Harith al-Awar, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The Dinar and the Dirham destroyed those who were before you, and they will destroy you as well.'

key_terms.الدِّرْهَم: Dirham, a silver coin used as currency
key_terms.الدِّينَار: Dinar, a gold coin used as currency

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the Dinar and Dirham destroying people?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi’s chapter on love of the world, this hadith utilizes the specific currency of the era (Dinar and Dirham) as metonyms for material wealth, linking the spiritual downfall of previous nations to the contemporary Muslim community. Shia scholars emphasize this as a warning against the internal corruption of greed (shuhh) that distracts from divine remembrance and communal justice. The narration serves as a foundational text for understanding how economic attachment can lead to the erosion of faith and societal cohesion.
